name: create_case
description: Register a new non-conformity case with a DRAFT procedure that awaits expert validation. Call after search_ncr_history and once the draft procedure and contractor e-mail are known.

procedure.description: The draft procedure as numbered steps.

contractor_email.description: Contractor/provider e-mail that will receive the validated procedure.

kb_references.description: Comma-separated refs/sources of the similar past reports used (optional).

name: get_case
description: Get a non-conformity case by id: status, draft procedure, validation decision and contractor e-mail state. Technicians only see their own cases; the conformity expert can see any case.

name: list_cases
description: List non-conformity cases. The conformity expert gets the validation queue (status PENDING_VALIDATION by default); a technician gets their own cases, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional status filter: PENDING_VALIDATION, APPROVED, REJECTED or CONTRACTOR_NOTIFIED.

name: record_validation
description: EXPERT ONLY: record the conformity expert's validation decision on a case. Refused for non-experts by both the Cedar policy at the Gateway and this tool.
